inputs.original_text:
Three months after the mandate was issued, activists in Uttar Pradesh say the government still hasn’t clarified how brick kiln operators can obtain the required environmental clearance, causing ongoing confusion and criticism from industry stakeholders and legal experts.

Kiln owners say they already have State Pollution Control Board approvals for water and air quality standards and are willing to obtain additional clearances if the process is streamlined and free from middlemen interference, which has historically been a challenge. Legal professionals say recent court decisions must be followed and are urging the state to address the oversight and set up an effective approval framework. Resolving the issue matters for both the industry and the environment.
